# dsh-plugin-balance-chip

A live DeepSeek account balance chip for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. It sits in the
session header

next to the other header actions and shows the remaining credit, the
unused bonus credit, and when
the number was last read.

在 DeepSeek Harness 的会话标题栏实时显示账户余额：主数字是账户余额，`+` 后面是尚未用完的赠送额度，
悬停可看更新时间，点击立即刷新。
## What it does

- Reads `ctx.remote.account.getBalance()` — the same Host-side platform query the
Settings → Account

panel uses. The browser never holds the account token.
- Refreshes every 20 seconds while the page

is visible, and immediately when the window
regains focus or the tab becomes visible again.
- Hides

itself when signed out; shows a red dot and “balance unavailable” on failure,
and a click retries.
-
Follows the interface language (zh / en) and the theme's CSS variables.

latest release

ry is listed in the plugin market, Settings →
Plugins will find it there as well.
## Files
| File | Role |

| `lib/index.js` | Host half — an empty mount that gives the Loader an enabled entry |
| `lib/client

.js` | Browser half — slot registration, polling store, chip component |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The
Loader row this bundle inserts (`id: balance-chip`) |
## Development

`tools/smoke-client.mjs` (in the contributing workspace) simulates the DSH module loader,
React, and

the account Remote to check the bundle id, exports, slot registration,
polling state machine, and t
he rendered amount text.
